_comment: Candidate Open Government Data Platform (data.gov.in) datasets for PMKK / ITI / PMKVY / SDC training centres. IMPORTANT: every resourceUuid below is an EMPTY STRING. I verified that each dataset TITLE and its data.gov.in resource/catalog slug is real (via search results and the live resource page), but I could NOT confirm the UUID — the new data.gov.in site is a client-rendered SPA whose resource pages return only boilerplate HTML, and its backend listing APIs (/backend/dms/v1, /backend/cust-api/v1/search) 302-redirect to a login wall. The UUID is only visible inside a successful api.data.gov.in response, which requires a key. So: DO NOT paste a UUID here unless you have copied it from a real api.data.gov.in response (or from the dataset page's API tab after logging in). A wrong UUID that 'works' is worse than an empty one — an empty UUID makes the importer fail loudly instead of silently pulling garbage.
_uuidGuidance: To fill a UUID: register a free account at https://www.data.gov.in/ (Register -> get an API key), open the dataset page listed below, click the 'API' tab, and copy the UUID from the URL https://www.data.gov.in/resource/<uuid>?api-key=YOUR_KEY. Then paste it into the matching resourceUuid field and re-run `npm run data:fetch`.
